figurative_meaning_en: To hold someone accountable to their promise or to demand fulfillment of a commitment
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি যে কথা দিয়েছিলে, সেটা এখন কথা নাও।
বন্ধু তার প্রতিশ্রুতি ভুলে গেছে, তাই আমি কথা নিলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: You gave your word, so now hold him to it.
My friend forgot his promise, so I held him accountable.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural emphasis on verbal promises in Bengali society, where spoken words carry significant weight.
